changeSet.sql: UPDATE rbac_policy_items rpi JOIN resource_actions ra ON rpi.resource_action_id = ra.resource_action_id JOIN resource_types rt ON ra.resource_type_id = ra.resource_type_id JOIN scopes s ON s.scope_id = rpi.scope_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = rpi.role_id JOIN rbac_policies rp ON rpi.policy_id = rp.policy_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = rp.project_id SET rpi.resource_type_key = rt.resource_type_key, rpi.action_name = ra.action_name, rpi.role_key = r.role_key, rpi.scope_key = s.scope_key, rpi.project_key = p.project_key, rpi.policy_key = rp.policy_key, rpi.policy_description = rp.description
